BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)
CLASS: BBA  SEMESTER: V
BRANCH: Management  SESSION: MO/2025

SUBJECT: MN410 BANKING CONCEPTS AND PRACTICE
TIME: 02 Hours  FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


   CO BL
Q.1 What is central banking? Discuss the various types of banking systems with their merits
and demerits.
[2+3] 1 2


Q.2. Discuss the Role of Reserve bank of India as
a. Monetary authority      b. Banker and debt manager to Govt.
[2+3] 1 2


Q.3 Discuss  the  primary  and  secondary  functions  of  commercial  banks.  How  do  these
functions contribute to the overall growth of an economy?
[5] 2 3


Q.4 Commercial  banks  are  often  referred  to  as  the  backbone  of  the  financial  system.
Analyse  this  statement  with  reference  to  their  functions  in  mobilizing  savings  and
channelling them into investments.
[5] 2 3


Q.5 A  customer  maintains  a  savings  account  with  a  commercial  bank.  One  day,  the
customer issues  a cheque  without  sufficient balance. Explain the  banker’s  role  and
responsibility in this situation.
[5] 3 3,4
